map.由距离与方位角求坐标增量: Coordinate Increments from Distance and Azimuth
map.输入距离 D 与方位角 α（度），求北向与东向增量。: Enter distance D and azimuth α (degrees) to obtain the northing and easting increments.
map.📖 查看「由距离与方位角求坐标增量 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Coordinate Increments from Distance and Azimuth User Guide"
map.由基线距离与偏角算垂直偏距。: Compute the perpendicular offset from a baseline distance and deflection angle.
map.沿基线距离 50m、偏角 30° → 垂直偏距=50×sin30°=25m；偏角: Baseline distance 50 m, deflection angle 30° → perpendicular offset = 50×sin30° = 25 m; at 90° the offset equals the full 50 m.
map.道路中心线外 25m 布边桩，用基线距+偏角快速钉桩，免逐点坐标。: Set edge stakes 25 m outside the road centerline using baseline distance + deflection angle for quick staking, avoiding per-point coordinates.
map.是垂直偏距=基线距×sin(偏角)；若用斜距要乘 sin 而非直接等于。: It is the perpendicular offset = baseline distance × sin(deflection angle); if using the slant distance, multiply by sin rather than equating directly.
map.偏距 0，点在基线上，无需横移。: Offset 0, the point is on the baseline and needs no lateral shift.
